before.name: Toxic Release Inventory on-site releases per capita
before.source: EPA Toxics Release Inventory (TRI) Basic Data Files, Reporting Year 2024, New York State — county totals queried via EPA Envirofacts efservice (table MV_TRI_BASIC_DOWNLOAD, filtered st=NY, year=2024, county=<each NYC county>); population denominator from U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program, Vintage 2024 county totals

scoring.worked_math: Per-county on-site release totals (EPA TRI Basic Data File / MV_TRI_BASIC_DOWNLOAD, RY2024, sum of the pre-computed 'on-site release total' field — fugitive air + stack air + water + underground injection + on-site land disposal — across every facility-chemical record, verified row-for-row against the table's own COUNT endpoint so no records were dropped): Queens (19/19 records) = 116+204+0.2+27720+0.0105475+0+33.116+0+0+77088+20256.3+0.0082+0.0001+0.03+0+0.0022+1.72+3.64+5330 = 130,753.03 lb. Kings (22/22 records) = 0+0+0+41208.93+0+2+73+38.55+2+3.18+0.06105+0+92.35+956.22+272.01+514.6+101.43+725.52+303.62+0+0.0161+0 = 44,293.49 lb. New York/Manhattan county (5 records retrieved; 2 excluded — Blackstone Advanced Technologies, Jamestown NY, self-reports county field 'NEW YORK' but sits at lat 42.11/lon -79.22 in Chautauqua County, ~380 mi from Manhattan, so its 2 records (10 lb + 10 lb on-site) are a facility self-report data-quality error and are dropped) = Consolidated Edison East River Facility: 363.419+7.17+28361.91 = 28,732.50 lb. Bronx (6/6 records, all Sprague Bronx Terminal) = 340.19+0+0.0198+0+0.00382+1015.55 = 1,355.76 lb. Richmond/Staten Island (5/5 records, all Pratt Paper NY) = 1+5093.6+0+0.4+4.4 = 5,099.40 lb. Citywide total = 130,753.03 + 44,293.49 + 28,732.50 + 1,355.76 + 5,099.40 = 210,234.18 lb. Population (US Census Bureau Vintage 2024 county population estimates, co-est2024-alldata.csv): Bronx 1,418,207 + Kings 2,736,038 + New York 1,629,153 + Queens 2,331,143 + Richmond 495,747 = 8,610,288. Per capita = 210,234.18 / 8,610,288 = 0.02442 lb/resident/year. level_pct (lower_is_better) = (value − target) / scale × 100 = (0.02442 − 1) / 1 × 100 = −97.56.

after.name: Quantified TRI Form R on-site releases per capita
after.source: US EPA TRI Basic Data Files 2024; US Census county population Vintage 2025
after.notes: EPA reportingyear 2024 quantified Form R releases 210234.1768175 lb / July 1,2024 Census Vintage 2025 population 8596825. 9 Form A records have unquantified releases, not measured zeros. The configured total TRI-release metric therefore remains incompletely quantified. No score asserted for this qualified observed lowerbound. Reporting thresholds and coveredindustries restrict TRI coverage.
